overview: You wrote three lines on the tables. The night is the long tale and then behind the cloth. The two cloaks are for the morning. A jig is only if my lord leaves it. You did not write a sum.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the three lines and stopped.

assets.name: The Comedy of Errors
assets.disposition: Wrote three lines and set the pen down

summary: Wrote three lines and set the pen down
